title: Global ML Model Training Opt-In Default
description: To power intelligent features like search relevance, channel recommendations, and emoji suggestions, we will use customer messaging data to train global, non-generative machine learning models. By default, all workspaces will be opted-in to this data collection. Users cannot opt-out individually; instead, Org Owners must email feedback@slack.com to request an opt-out. Note: This data is NOT used for Generative AI (Slack AI) features.
expected_impact: Will significantly improve the accuracy of Slack's global ML models by maximizing the training data pool, leading to better search and recommendations for all users.
dependencies: Customer Experience team email workflow for opt-outs
